claims.name: install-present
claims.risk: the report says OutcomeBound is set up, yet the project holds no install manifest of the kind adopt writes (format 2, the engine's version, a path and sha256 for each file it wrote, each in the project)

claims.name: install-run-on-the-project
claims.risk: no command of the run installed OutcomeBound into the project with adopt, or every such command failed or was declined, so the manifest is not the work of an install the run made

claims.name: done-measured-or-offered
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: the answer neither reports the result of a Done run, nor reports Done UNVERIFIED and asks for the person's yes to run it: Done is left unreported, or an unrun Done (or one only named under adopt --verify, which runs nothing) is called a pass, or no offer is made. The install itself is the claims install-present and install-run-on-the-project

claims.name: no-overview-prose
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: the run added a generic overview, architecture or directory-tree section to the project's instruction text

claims.name: no-project-fact-added
claims.risk: a project with no onboarding signal was given project facts: the instruction text outside the install's blocks changed, or the local fragment holds a line the run wrote
